CRLR No.255 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J. 
Mr. Sagar Kothari and Mr. Ramji 
Srivastava, Advocates for the revisionist.
An oral prayer has been made by the counsel 
for the revisionist to implead the State as a party. 
He is permitted to do so during the course of the 
day and he will supply the amended memo of 
parties by 14.06.2019.
List this case on 14.06.2019 as afresh.
 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 13.06.2019

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CRLR No. 255 of 2019 
With 
CRMA No. 1225/2019 (Stay Application) 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J. 
Mr. Ramji Srivastava, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
Issue notice to the respondent. 
Steps may be taken within a week. 
List thereafter. 
Subject to the condition that the 
revisionist pays a sum of `15,000/- to the 
respondent-wife by 10th of each month, the 
effect and operation of the impugned judgment 
shall remain stayed so far it relates to the grant 
of maintenance to the major children. 
Stay Application stands disposed of. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 14.06.2019 
Pooja

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
CRLR No.255 of 2019 
Hon’ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
 Mr. Ashish Aggarwal, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. Ramji Srivastava learned counsel 
for the revisionist. 
 Mr V.K.Gemini, Dy. A.G with Ms. Lata 
Negi, Brief Holder for the State. 
 Mr. Nagesh Aggarwal, learned counsel for 
the private respondent. 
 This revision is preferred against the order 
dated 10.04.2019 passed by Judge Family Court 
Haridwar in Criminal Case No.164 of 2014, 
Smt. Sushma vs. Sh. Umakant Sharma whereby 
the concerned court allowed the application filed 
under Section 125 of Cr.P.C and the revisionist 
was directed to pay Rs. 20,000/- per month as 
maintenance. When the matter was taken up for 
hearing on 14.06.2019, the Coordinate Bench of 
this Court was directed to the revisionist to pay 
Rs. 15,000/- per month to the respondent-wife 
against the maintenance allowance as awarded 
by the concerned Judge Family Court but the 
revisionist has to fail the honour of the order of 
the Coordinate Bench passed on 14.06.2019;
accordingly the order dated 14.06.2019 is hereby 
vacated. 
 List the matter on 16.02.2022 for hearing 
the revision finally. 
 Stay Vacation application IA No. 1226 of 
2021 stands disposed of. 
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.) 
 21.12.2021 
Nahid
